script.welcome: Good morning Pam. I'm Stratton. Wednesday is the back of the body and a lovely stretch, about ten minutes. Everything is chair based or standing with support. If the hips or knees are grumbly today, take a smaller range. You've shown up, and that's the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Sit tall, feet flat, easy breath.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Have a little wriggle if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work, Pam. Strong hips, a long back, and another day in the book. See you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SIT TO STAND
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat and hip-width, a little behind the knees. Lean the chest forward slightly and press through the heels to stand tall, squeezing the bottom gently at the top. Sit back down slowly with control. Use your hands on the thighs or the chair arms any time. A partial stand is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Sit to stand to wake up the hips and the back of the legs. Two sets of six. Lean forward a little, press through the heels, stand tall, then sit down slowly. Hands on the thighs are always fine.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Sit back and breathe easy.
exercises.speakDone: Sit to stand done. Strong hips, well done.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Arms reach forward, light weights or empty hands. Draw the elbows back alongside the ribs and gently squeeze the shoulder blades together, then reach forward again with control. Shoulders stay down away from the ears. A smaller pull is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row for the upper back. Two sets of eight. Reach forward, draw the elbows back, gentle squeeze between the shoulder blades. Empty hands are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Let the arms hang loose. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair. Straighten one leg out in front with the heel on the floor and toes up; the other foot stays flat. Sit tall, then hinge gently forward from the hips, hands sliding toward the knee or shin, until you feel a mild stretch in the back of the leg. Breathe slowly. No bouncing, no pain. Swap legs on the second set. Only go as far as feels kind.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach, a gentle stretch for the back of the leg. Two sets of about twenty seconds, one leg each set. One heel out in front, sit tall, hinge forward just until you feel a mild stretch. Breathe slowly. Not far is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Sit up tall and swap legs.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand beside a sturdy chair, light fingertips on the backrest for support. Stand tall, shoulders soft and down. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other foot just a little — a toe tap is plenty. Soft knee on the standing leg. Hold about fifteen seconds, then switch sides. Use more hand support any time.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance to finish, standing tall. Two sets of about fifteen seconds each side. Light fingertips on the chair, shoulders soft, lift one foot just a little. More support is always fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Both feet down. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session, lovely work.
